retail.tool_evidence: Binary Ninja MCP bn_function_info, bn_function_callees, bn_function_disassembly and bn_function_decompile on retail igi.exe at 0x00405850.

findings: The candidate call order and branch selection match the retail disassembly exactly: Qvm_Load; non-null path Qvm_Execute, Qvm_Cleanup, SaveSoundOptions, NoD3DDriversWithHard, Language_2; null path SaveGraphicOptions first, then SaveSoundOptions, NoD3DDriversWithHard, Language_2.
The candidate returns the Config_Language_2 result on both paths, as retail returns the EAX of its last call.

The candidate calls the namespaced igi::retail::script::Qvm_Load and Qvm_Cleanup, which the target defines; Qvm_Execute and the four Config_* callees are extern "C" declarations with no definition in the target.
The source's behavior comment mislabels 0x004B80B0/0x004B85B0/0x004B83D0 as file natives; they are Qvm_Load, Qvm_Execute and Qvm_Cleanup.
